source_root: External archive configured by TIA_PROJECTS_ROOT; exports are not included in this runtime package
coverage: Partial: verified station/cell stop messages, MB150-MB260 MC07B conveyor faults, and PROFINET device115 loss inCell1; no prompt messages; unknown faults requireEW1/ErrH fallback
verification: Direct MSG.W positions checked against03Msg_Word resets/execution order, literal CFG wiring and network titles. MC07B positions traced from station CFG_MsgWord, first OBJ1 call,15 unconditional02Msg_Stn calls and final word increment; prompts9,14 excluded.

alarms.text: Потеря связи с устройством PROFINET №115
alarms.original: Site lost, system diagnostics: first FOR I=1..256 calls01Msg_Cell with CFG_MsgType=Msg_ErrType.Communication. Caller Msg_word=0. DeviceI=115 explicitly mapsNumber=1. Word=floor((115-1)/16)=7;bit=(115-1)%16=2. Second loopW23.2 is ErrPrompt and excluded.
